scenes.name: title
scenes.narration: Vigil. A post-quantum rollup on QoreChain, with a watchtower that never sleeps.

scenes.name: problem
scenes.caption: A rollup is only as honest as the people watching it
scenes.narration: A rollup posts summaries of its transactions to the base chain. The chain accepts each summary and waits an hour for anyone to prove it wrong. If nobody is watching, a dishonest batch becomes final.

scenes.name: diagram
scenes.caption: Sign, batch, check, settle, record
scenes.narration: With Vigil, users sign with M L D S A. A bonded batcher submits each batch with a post-quantum anchor. The watchtower re-executes every batch from its own verified copy of the inbox, and challenges a wrong one with a fraud proof.

scenes.name: overview
scenes.caption: Live on the QoreChain testnet
scenes.narration: Everything here is live on the QoreChain testnet: the settlement flow, the batches still in their challenge window, and every service's heartbeat.

scenes.name: batches
scenes.caption: Two opinions on every batch: ours and the chain's
scenes.narration: Each batch shows two independent opinions: the watchtower's re-execution, and the chain's own status.

scenes.name: pq
scenes.caption: ML-DSA-87, ML-DSA-44 and ML-KEM-1024
scenes.narration: Final batches are recorded on chain by a contract that checks the M L D S A 87 signature itself. Private memos are sealed with M L KEM.

scenes.name: end
scenes.narration: Vigil. Open source, and running now.
